note: RV park in Florence near the Ohio River. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $45-55, 50A/water/sewer, year-round; added phone booking, laundry.
flags: GATE: $45 posted nightly (Sun-Thu), $55 Fri-Sat, under the $50 gate at base; the page carries no rate date beyond a 2020 copyright, so the rate's date is unproven. Weekly $250 works out to about $36 a night. No gateway: Cincinnati 50 km, Louisville 93 km. Good Sam not checked. Presence: working site with phone 812-653-1657; Google 4.8/34.

LONG-STAY: five tests, my read: long-stay in character but not plainly mostly seasonal. Against: operator calls guests "tenants" and says "suited for tenants to experience great long term riverside living"; rates "on a daily, monthly or yearly basis". For: posted nightly rate and phone booking (test 2 passes); Google reviews include travelers ("We travel often"; "I look forward to going back again") alongside stayers ("Stayed here through the winter"; "Well worth staying for a while or longer!"). Test 4 (share of nightly sites) is unpublished: no count or split anywhere; imagery shows roughly 10-15 gravel pads in the main loop, several occupied by RVs with sheds nearby, which proves nothing either way.

WATER LEAD: stored riverview is not proven from an RV pad. Operator says "located on the Ohio riverfront" and "the beautiful view", but those are marketing; the one site photo shows pads with a metal building and no river, and the sunset photo is taken from the bank, not a site. Imagery: main-loop pads ~150 m from the river across mown lawn, past a building and a house, with a tree band along much of the bank (gaps exist). A review says "I love being close to the water", which is no view claim. Under the unsure-goes-down rule this reads as not waterfront unless a pad photo turns up.
PIN: on the pad loop, good.
NOT STATED: site count, rig length (site photo shows a large fifth wheel, wide gravel pads), showers, toilets, dump, floods. The attractions page has nothing on closures. Overpass down this session.
